name: inversion identification
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 由可测车辆响应反推轮轨力的识别。

complete_examples.text: Vehicle-track system Hybrid recursive CNN-LSTM Wheel-rail force Inversion identification Variational mode decomposition A B S T R A C T This paper aims to propose a practical framework for fast inversion and identification of wheel-rail forces of railway based on deep learning, with a view of achieving continuous measurement of the wheel-rail forces of the entire railway line in real time by means of the easily-measure vibration response of the train.

In addition, the model-based prediction method requires 12 minutes, while the deep learning method proposed only takes 4 s. Therefore, the inversion identification method based on vehicle vibration acceleration exhibits promising potential in real-time monitoring of continuous wheel-rail forces.
